# Privacy Policy

Candidate version: **2026-10-09-beta-rc2**. **DRAFT — NOT APPROVED, NOT EFFECTIVE, NOT PUBLISHED.** Owner review does not establish approval. These documents must be reconciled with verified implementation and applicable Australian obligations before account activation.

Operator: Ginty United Investments Pty Ltd · ABN 78 606 187 106 · support@docked.com.au. Correspondence address remains restricted.

## Restricted beta scope

Australia only; invitation-only for the owner and at most ten invited testers, all aged 18+. Participation is free. Public registration, deposits, withdrawals, paid cards/packs, marketplace transactions, cash prizes and rewards with monetary value are disabled. Beta cards and points have no monetary value and cannot be redeemed or sold. Beta inventory, entitlements, transactions, statistics and rankings remain separate from official records. No unvalidated official betting recommendations are published. The owner handles support and moderation; the designated administrator and contact is support@docked.com.au.

The operator above is responsible for Docked's handling of personal information. Docked uses account email and identifiers, username/profile, self-attested age and country/state, consent versions, preferences, authentication and security records. Passwords are submitted to the authentication service. The game stores card allocations and ownership history, pack claims, gameplay points, teams, competitions and results. Social features store submitted posts/comments/images, relationships, reactions, saves, reports, blocks, mutes and notifications. Do not submit identity documents, payment-card details, sportsbook credentials or precise GPS location; these are not needed for the approved launch.

Information is used to authenticate accounts, run the game, enforce scarcity and ownership, prevent abuse, moderate social features, respond to support requests and record consent. Profile/social visibility follows the product's access and blocking rules; private preferences, reports and saves are not public. Optional analytics and marketing consent remain separate from necessary account/security processing. Optional outbound marketing and Android push are not enabled by this release. Historical storefront mailing lists are not imported into Fantasy communications.

The intended production providers are now Vercel for website delivery, Supabase for authentication/database services in Sydney, and Microsoft 365 for support and transactional email. Netlify is retained but is no longer the selected beta host. Only necessary data should be sent to each provider. Supabase's current residency guidance describes regional database/Auth/storage and backup hosting, with some support, service metadata and delivery processing outside the region, including US/Singapore support and EU logs. Vercel functions are configured for Sydney; this alone does not establish exclusive Australian processing. Review the applicable Vercel subprocessors and processing locations before finalizing the overseas disclosure. Microsoft mailbox geography depends on the tenant's actual configuration, which still needs administrator verification. The launch policy must identify likely overseas recipients/countries where practicable; it must not promise that all data stays in Australia. The restricted beta uses separate gameplay namespaces inside the dedicated production project, with shared authentication identity services. The older isolated Preview database is not used for these accounts.

Members can use the available account controls to change preferences, export data and request deletion. The operator must verify these flows against production before promising them publicly. Deletion must revoke access and remove or pseudonymise eligible profile/social data while preserving the minimum lawful audit and scarcity evidence. Pseudonymous identifiers may still be personal information; an immutable transaction requirement is not a blanket justification to retain all personal information forever. Final retention/destruction periods, backup expiry, exceptions/legal holds and account-to-ledger unlinking need documented review and implementation verification.

For access, correction, deletion or privacy concerns, contact support@docked.com.au using the complaints procedure in the Community Guidelines. Requested access may need to be limited to protect another person's information or satisfy applicable law; explain a refusal and review options where required. Security incidents must be assessed promptly, contained and notified to affected people/regulators when applicable legal thresholds are met. The owner is the proposed contact for privacy requests and incident coordination as part of the operating commitments in this approval packet.

## Retention disclosure and implementation review

The following is an evidence-based internal schedule for approval, not a claim that every automatic cleanup already runs in production. No retention period is presented as a universal legal requirement.

| Category | Existing implementation / proposed decision |
| --- | --- |
| Account and authentication | Beta access is revoked and eligible beta profile/social information is erased through the scoped account workflow. Shared Auth identities and official sessions are not automatically deleted by beta suspension. Operator-assisted identity cleanup, residual records and retries must be verified before external activation. Aim to respond to a verified request within 30 days; do not promise completed erasure before the actual workflow is tested. |
| Social profile/content | Account disablement clears profile identity, removes post/comment bodies and media associations, and removes private social preferences/relationships through database triggers. Verify residual media/logs and worker execution in production. |
| Gameplay ownership and claims | Immutable records currently retain the original account UUID in membership, cards, packs, claims, entries and result history. They contain no email field, but are not necessarily anonymous. Preserve scarcity and provenance; obtain a documented necessity/retention assessment and define account-link minimization before public launch. Do not assert indefinite retention of all personal data is legally required. |
| Data access/export | Current account export covers account, consent and community data, but does not yet include a complete Fantasy historical export. Do not describe the self-service export as a complete copy of all gameplay data. Provide a verified support-assisted route until a scoped historical export is implemented and tested. |
| Temporary social data | Existing maintenance queries erase expired quarantined uploads, expired notifications and completed notification jobs older than 90 days. Their presence in source is not evidence that a production scheduler is running. |
| Support/complaints and sent Auth mail | Proposed review point: 12 months after the case closes for routine support, with longer documented retention only where necessary for disputes/legal obligations; promptly remove expired verification-message bodies where no longer needed. Microsoft 365 retention/hold rules need administrator confirmation before selecting final expiry values. |
| Security logs and backups | Verify actual provider expiry and restore behavior; do not promise immediate deletion from backups. Configure the shortest operationally adequate periods within existing plans, and ensure restoration does not restore deleted users' access. No paid retention add-on is approved. |
| Optional analytics/marketing | Keep marketing disabled and optional analytics consent separate. Existing account erasure deletes per-user analytics; no historical marketing lists are imported. Confirm any wider event-expiry schedule before stating a fixed duration. |

Before external activation, verify the final retention/hold settings and the support-assisted deletion/export path with a controlled account. Owner approval of this wording does not certify unverified provider settings or erase these checks. Record reasons and review dates for retained identifiers rather than using “immutable” as a blanket privacy exception.

### Controlled beta conditions — exact wording pending approval

The beta is invitation-only for adults aged 18 or older located in Australia, limited to ten invited testers in addition to the designated owner. Public registration remains closed. Beta is experimental: availability, incomplete features and known limitations must be disclosed before use. Only supported, verified actions should be described as working. Contact support@docked.com.au for support/privacy assistance.

Beta gameplay and rankings must be distinguished from future official launch records. Beta inventory, lifetime starter entitlements and rankings do not consume or become official launch records; this does not authorize deleting or rewriting immutable ownership/history records. Any transition must preserve those records and follow the approved privacy/retention process. Fictional players and simulated statistics remain labeled. No official betting recommendation may be published without the existing model validation and publication controls. No monetary prize, paid pack or reward with monetary value is offered by this beta.

Australia-only scope and owner support/moderation responsibility are confirmed. Retention, regulatory applicability, final policy versions and functional verification remain prerequisites to external testers.

Docked Fantasy Cards is operated by **Ginty United Investments Pty Ltd, ABN 78 606 187 106**. It is a free-to-join fantasy collection and team game. Cards are digital game records, not financial assets, NFTs, shares, deposits or promises of investment returns. Gameplay points cannot be transferred, withdrawn, redeemed for money or used to purchase paid packs. Buying, selling and trading are disabled for this launch. There are no entry fees, monetary prizes, deposits, withdrawals or payment processing.

Members must be at least 18, satisfy the published location eligibility rules, verify their account email, and accept the current Terms and acknowledge the Privacy Policy. The owner-authorized beta territory is Australia only. Applicable state/territory eligibility still requires a verified database policy and legal assessment; worldwide access is not authorized. Do not share accounts, impersonate others, evade restrictions, automate reward claims, exploit errors or create accounts to farm rewards. Email verification and rate limits reduce abuse but do not prove that every account represents a different person.

The player catalogue used for the initial game is fictional and must be labelled as such. Do not describe simulated scores as real professional sporting performance. A card's edition and serial identify its place in a predefined, finite supply. Rarity does not multiply fantasy performance scores. Valid formations, eligibility, lineup deadlines and the applicable scoring rules are shown with each competition. Saved lineups remain subject to the server's lock time. Device clocks do not control eligibility or locks. Corrections must preserve the audit trail rather than silently rewrite results.

Pack allocation and ownership changes are recorded by the server. Refreshing, retrying or using another device does not create another entitlement. A digital card provides the game use described here; it is not a promise that a particular player will remain eligible for every future round. Membership, rewards and social features may be restricted to investigate abuse or protect other members. Members can request an explanation or review at support@docked.com.au. Nothing in these terms excludes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded under applicable consumer law.

Keep your login and verification links private, and contact support if your account may be compromised. Maintenance, outages and finite inventory can interrupt access; no uninterrupted availability or investment return is promised. Material changes to these terms must be shown before they apply, with renewed acceptance where required. Changes cannot rewrite earlier ownership receipts or retrospectively increase a launched edition's supply. On closure, beta gameplay access ends; the separate Privacy Policy governs remaining records. Closing a beta account does not restore a consumed beta starter entitlement and does not consume an official launch entitlement.

The existing Docked Edge research service remains separate. Its preserved research terms, performance disclaimers and access restrictions continue to apply to Edge. Fantasy gameplay points and fictional scores do not become Edge performance records. Historical product orders and support obligations are also separate.

# Community Guidelines

## Restricted beta scope

Australia only; invitation-only for the owner and at most ten invited testers, all aged 18+. Participation is free. No unvalidated official betting recommendations are published. The owner handles support and moderation; the designated administrator and contact is support@docked.com.au.

Be respectful. Do not post harassment, threats, hate, sexual exploitation, pornography or other adult-only sexual material, graphic violence, promotion of self-harm, private personal information without permission, scams, illegal material, impersonation or content you lack permission to share. Do not offer cash sales, external paid packs, gambling promotions or reward-farming services through Docked. Do not offer to buy, sell or redeem beta cards, points or accounts for anything of monetary value. Do not manipulate results, coordinate abusive account creation or encourage security exploits.

Use the report, block and mute controls when appropriate. Uploaded images are subject to moderation; selecting an image does not itself publish it. Reports and private preferences are not public posts. Moderators may restrict visibility or account access under the applicable policy, with privileged actions recorded. Request a review at support@docked.com.au, identifying the relevant post or decision without reposting harmful material. Review requests must be considered fairly; no continuous moderation coverage or instant response is promised. For immediate danger, contact emergency services. Applicable illegal-content reporting and eSafety escalation obligations must be assessed before enabling community access for external testers. An invitation limit and an 18+ checkbox are not assumed to exempt the service.

## Complaints and privacy requests — procedure for approval

Email **support@docked.com.au** with “Docked complaint”, “Moderation appeal” or “Privacy request”, a short description, relevant dates and the outcome sought. Provide your username or account email where needed, not passwords, verification links, payment information or unnecessary identity documents. A representative may be asked for appropriate authority. Docked may request proportionate information to verify an account-related request without routinely collecting government identity documents.

The owner is responsible for acknowledging receipt, assessing the relevant records and explaining the outcome and available review options, involving an authorized adviser when necessary. We aim to respond within 30 calendar days; if more time is needed, explain why and provide an update. For a moderation appeal, use a different reviewer where practicable. Record only the information needed to handle the complaint and any justified follow-up. These response commitments are part of this exact-version approval request.

Where the Privacy Act applies, a person who is dissatisfied with Docked's response, or has received no response after 30 days, may complain to the [Office of the Australian Information Commissioner](https://www.oaic.gov.au/privacy/privacy-complaints/lodge-a-privacy-complaint-with-us). This does not claim Docked belongs to an external dispute resolution scheme. Consumers may also seek advice from their state or territory consumer-protection authority. Applicable rights are not limited by this procedure.

# Fantasy Card Rules

Operator: Ginty United Investments Pty Ltd · ABN 78 606 187 106 · support@docked.com.au. Correspondence address remains restricted.

## Restricted beta scope

Australia only; invitation-only for the owner and at most ten invited testers, all aged 18+. Participation is free. Public registration, deposits, withdrawals, paid cards/packs, marketplace transactions, cash prizes and rewards with monetary value are disabled. Beta cards and points have no monetary value and cannot be redeemed or sold. Beta inventory, entitlements, transactions, statistics and rankings remain separate from official records. No unvalidated official betting recommendations are published. The owner handles support and moderation; the designated administrator and contact is support@docked.com.au.

Cards are server-recorded game items, not NFTs or investments. The initial player catalogue is fictional and must be labelled. Each edition has a predefined finite supply; serials and ownership history must be immutable. Rarity must not multiply performance points. Buying, selling and trading remain disabled.

Beta editions, allocation pools, packs, lifetime starter entitlements, claims, ownership and receipts now use separate database namespaces. Beta use does not consume official inventory or official account entitlements. The stock quantities below are beta configuration ceilings, not invitation places or a guarantee of currently available stock. Finite beta inventory must be initialized and verified before claims are enabled.

- **Starter:** one free pack of 11 CORE cards per eligible verified beta member account, claimed after the required onboarding/consent. The formation allocation is 1 goalkeeper, 4 defenders, 4 midfielders and 2 forwards, with unique players within the pack. Claims are permanently recorded and cannot be reset by retries or later inventory releases. Initial allocation is 1,000 Starter packs; additional bounded releases require an authorized MFA administrator and cannot increase permanent edition caps. If stock is unavailable, no successful claim is recorded. The launch homepage must disclose availability rather than promise unlimited immediate stock.
- **Daily:** claim 10 non-transferable gameplay points once in each UTC calendar day after claiming the Starter. The server displays the next claim time. Missed periods are not backdated. A repeated request returns the original result; it does not grant another reward. A local calendar day can differ from the UTC reward period.
- **Every seventh successful claim:** a controlled one-card CORE reward pack is available subject to remaining inventory and the beta-wide daily card limit. These are seven successful claims, not necessarily seven consecutive days. Initial limits are 100 reward cards across all members per UTC day and 10,000 reward packs in the initial allocation. When card stock or the daily card limit is exhausted, the daily points still apply and the receipt records the reason no card pack was awarded. That receipt does not create an automatic later card entitlement.
- **Permanent records:** each claim records its applicable reward-policy version. The member view shows recent history; the database retains permanent claim and card-provenance records. Neither points nor card rarity changes fantasy performance scoring. Cards and points have no monetary value, cash redemption, prize conversion or permitted resale.
- **Changes:** reward configuration can be changed only through authorized MFA administration within the implemented bounds. The launch configuration remains 10 points and a seven-claim interval. Any future member-facing change must be communicated accurately and must not rewrite previous receipts or increase a launched edition's supply cap.

# Competition and Points Rules

Candidate version: **2026-10-09-beta-rc2**. **DRAFT — NOT APPROVED, NOT EFFECTIVE, NOT PUBLISHED.** Owner review does not establish approval. These documents must be reconciled with verified implementation and applicable Australian obligations before account activation.

Operator: Ginty United Investments Pty Ltd · ABN 78 606 187 106 · support@docked.com.au. Correspondence address remains restricted.

## Restricted beta scope

Australia only; invitation-only for the owner and at most ten invited testers, all aged 18+. Participation is free. Public registration, deposits, withdrawals, paid cards/packs, marketplace transactions, cash prizes and rewards with monetary value are disabled. Beta cards and points have no monetary value and cannot be redeemed or sold. Beta inventory, entitlements, transactions, statistics and rankings remain separate from official records. No unvalidated official betting recommendations are published. The owner handles support and moderation; the designated administrator and contact is support@docked.com.au.

Gameplay points, fantasy performance scores and member edge benchmark units are separate measures. None is money, withdrawable value or a paid entry mechanism. No pay-to-win rarity multiplier, entry fee, cash prize or other reward with monetary value is enabled.

Each fantasy round must display its approved scoring version, player eligibility, formation, server lock timestamp and correction rules before entry. Device time cannot extend a lock. Results must use authorized fictional or verified data, labelled accurately. Corrections preserve prior records and reasons. Final scoring schedules and enabled round formats must be included in the approval before competitions are opened.

The existing member-edge ranking rule is top-docked-net-units-v1: a one-unit benchmark; a win produces decimal odds minus one, a loss minus one, and a void zero. Void stakes are excluded from the settled non-void ROI denominator. Pending or disputed entries must not be reported as settled wins. The current rule specifies at least 20 settled entries and seven active days, primary net standardized units, then lower maximum drawdown and profile ID tie-breakers. Its monthly period basis is submitted_at_utc. Verify these rules against actual displayed monthly/lifetime queries before publication; the separate official research ledger has a different reporting basis and must not be substituted.

Member edges require a verified market reference for the exact event/selection/line and freshness rules. If reliable odds are unavailable, do not accept invented verified prices or present manually authored fixtures as real provider coverage. Settlement requires verified win/loss/void evidence for the same market contract.

Beta member statistics, fantasy results and community rankings use separate namespaces and must not enter official monthly/lifetime totals. Technical isolation tests have passed. Positive hosted acceptance and accurate display of the applicable scoring version remain prerequisites to enabling a round; beta standings do not transfer into official records.
